g.text: Embedded Adobe RGB → sRGB; continuous colors, before palette selection or dithering
Yellow cells: 16×16 pixels with source linear-R range ≥ 0.025, but clipped R is constant throughout.
7 cells detected. Green/blue still vary: this is lost red gradation, not complete loss of texture.
